general: Future artifacts are not authorized merely by being named here.
Every phase requires its own explicit Sol decision and exact allowlist.
Identifiers must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,95}$ and must not contain path separators, traversal, aliases or forbidden legacy tokens.
All raw and receipt artifacts are write-once and content-addressed; overwrite, in-place revision and symlink resolution are forbidden.
Physical path and canonical identity must both be recorded where canonicalization applies.

bounded_source_discovery_contract.purpose: Resolve whether any grade-A or grade-B public source can support a later exact zero-cost D0 plan. Discovery proves documentation facts only.
discovery_only_sources: Any source requiring payment, entitlement, login, API key, cookie, browser challenge or jurisdictional attestation.
CME, Kaiko and Coin Metrics unless a later explicit entitlement and cost decision exists.
allowed_content: Official HTML, plain text, public schema examples, public license or terms pages, public change logs, public catalog metadata and checksum manifests that contain no market rows.
Exact canonical URL, access time, status code, content type, byte count, physical digest, publication or effective-version evidence and unresolved facts.
forbidden_content: OHLCV, trade, order-book, funding, open-interest, liquidation, macro observation or event rows.
Archive binaries, bulk market files, WebSocket streams or REST market responses.
Credentials, cookies, authenticated sessions, paid data, terms bypass, CAPTCHA bypass or regional-control bypass.
bounded_source_discovery_contract.unknown_rule: Unknown source identity, grade, owner, terms, schema, clock, revision, coverage, redirect, size or cost returns WAIT_DATA and cannot be converted to an assumption.

hard_failures: Unknown or changed terms, cost, content length, object identity, checksum, schema, product mapping, point-in-time semantics or chronology role.
Redirect outside the exact approved owner and host set.
An object overlaps January 2025, February 2025, the active G1 window or any reserved future holdout.
The output path aliases, resolves into or depends on Application Support, an old route root or an existing authority root.

required_clocks.event_time: When the measured market or economic event occurred or the observation period references. It never establishes information availability.
required_clocks.published_at: Exact source publication time for this revision when authoritative evidence exists; otherwise explicit UNKNOWN.
required_clocks.received_at: Earliest local time at which the exact bytes were fully observable to the authorized acquisition process.
required_clocks.ingested_at: Time at which exact bytes were durably persisted and their physical digest completed.
required_clocks.admission_validated_at: Time at which the pure admission validator completed against the exact persisted bytes and external authority values.

point_in_time_semantics_contract.available_at_rule: available_at is the maximum of every verified timestamp required for lawful and technical knowledge of that exact revision, including published_at when applicable, received_at, ingested_at and admission_validated_at. event_time, bar open or close time, archive folder date and current latest-revision timestamps cannot substitute.
point_in_time_semantics_contract.uncertainty_rule: If an exact publication or receipt clock is unavailable, classify the artifact as BATCH_ARCHIVE_RECEIPT_ONLY or UNKNOWN. It may support bounded engineering replay after admission but cannot be represented as decision-time available evidence.
point_in_time_semantics_contract.conservative_latency_rule: Uncertainty must delay availability, censor the row or suspend the affected lane; it may never make information earlier.

revision_rules: Revisions are append-only, acyclic and visible only at their own available_at.
A later correction, retraction or tombstone cannot rewrite earlier replay state.
Latest-revision backfill into an earlier decision timestamp is forbidden.
The full supersedes chain and operation must remain inspectable.
duplicate_and_conflict_rules: An exact duplicate with the same identity and payload digest is an idempotent no-op and creates no second effect.
The same identity with a different payload digest is a conflict, quarantines the object and suspends the affected lane.
Out-of-order arrivals are retained with their real clocks and later replayed by available_at; they are never reordered by event_time for decision visibility.
gap_rules: Source outage, acquisition failure, sequence gap, scheduled non-publication, market inactivity, censored observation, unknown coverage and quarantine are distinct typed states.
No missing row may be silently filled, forward-filled, set to zero or interpreted as no activity.
Coverage denominators retain unknown, abstained, quarantined and censored opportunities.
raw_byte_rules: Exact raw bytes are content-addressed and write-once.
Compressed bytes and decompressed members have separate physical digests and lineage.
Raw objects cannot be overwritten by corrected or newly downloaded objects.
Every admission receipt binds raw digest, byte length, source, plan, clocks, coverage, revision facts, validator version and authority values.
validator_rules: The public validator is pure, total and fail-closed over caller-supplied raw mappings.
Authority roots, route identity, type ceilings, path roots and permission ceilings are pinned outside candidate-controlled content.
Booleans are not integers; hash and identifier fields require exact string types and formats.
Candidate-provided acceptance flags, hashes, paths, receipts or authority names cannot establish their own validity.

adapter_and_replay_contract.adapter_input: Only exact D1-admitted artifacts and exact external admission receipts.
adapter_and_replay_contract.adapter_output: Versioned normalized rows plus deterministic adapter receipts retaining complete raw lineage.
adapter_forbidden: Prediction, utility, position, order or permission fields
Merging product families or instrument identities
adapter_and_replay_contract.source_sequence_rule: source_sequence is an authoritative native sequence when available, otherwise an explicitly named monotonic local receipt ordinal. It may never be derived from event_time or future information.
replay_invariants: Identical admitted input and frozen code produce identical normalized rows, event order, state transitions and receipt chain.
Revision selection is point-in-time and append-only.
Every replay receipt is domain-separated and chained to the prior receipt, admitted artifact set, adapter version and configuration identity.
Future rows, full-bar extremes before bar close and admission, favorable-first barrier ordering and gap interpolation are forbidden.
OHLC high and low are usable only after exact bar close plus admission availability.
MFE and MAE are outcome diagnostics available only after the evaluation horizon and never input features.
adapter_and_replay_contract.ambiguity_rule: When two barriers can be touched within an unsequenced aggregate bar, the result is AMBIGUOUS_OR_CENSORED unless an admitted finer-grained source resolves the order. Favorable ordering is forbidden.

development_dataset_and_comparison_contr.d3_boundary: D3 may later generate a point-in-time development trajectory dataset and receipts only. It may not score, rank or select policies.
development_dataset_and_comparison_contr.dynamic_policy_binding: DYNAMIC_MULTI_PATH must bind the exact accepted P0.1 dynamic-policy bundle and its deterministic event order, idempotency, position lock, non-expansive management actions and fail-closed gap or future semantics.
common_information_rules: All policies receive the same admitted point-in-time events and exact opportunity denominator.
All policies use the same chronology, fees, slippage, funding, risk budget, liquidity constraints and barrier ambiguity rule.
No policy receives post-outcome MFE, MAE, full-bar future extrema, latest revisions or another policy's future decisions.
NO_TRADE retains every eligible opportunity and its zero-action outcome in the denominator.
development_dataset_and_comparison_contr.evaluation_boundary: Any real-data four-policy score, statistical comparison, calibration, backtest, holdout or profitability assessment is E2 and requires a separate Sol decision. Calling it development, replay QA or D3 does not change its stage.

chronology_contract.first_access_rule: Any market or macro window becomes permanently SEEN for this program at the first request, listing, byte access, download attempt or supplied-artifact inspection, including failed or partial access.
chronology_contract.role_lock_rule: A seen engineering window can never later become calibration or holdout. Future calibration and one-time holdout roles must be assigned to non-overlapping exact windows before any access.
chronology_contract.failed_access_rule: Failed access still consumes the declared chronology role when it reveals object presence, absence, size, schema, coverage or content metadata.
chronology_contract.no_relabeling_rule: Development, calibration and holdout labels are immutable once first access occurs.

accept_pitar1_e0_requires: Exact workspace and every bound authority identity match this route.
Only the thirteen allowlisted E0 artifacts are new and no existing artifact is modified.
Every artifact has exact byte length and physical digest; each JSON contract and report has an independently recomputable domain-separated canonical digest.
No new artifact imports, aliases, copies or relies on old P1A, S0-009, active G1 or Application Support artifacts.
The validator is pure, total, type-strict, authority-pinned outside candidate content and fail-closed.
The exact clean candidate passes deterministic validation and independent helper-free adversarial mutations.
All eleven historical false-admission attacks are rejected.
Clock, revision, duplicate, conflict, gap, raw-byte, adapter and replay invariants have positive, boundary and negative synthetic fixtures.
Source discovery stayed inside official grade-A or grade-B documentation caps and acquired no market rows.
The D0 plan candidate states every unknown and grants no acquisition permission.
The report makes no market, predictive, probability, profitability, paper, deployment or trading claim.
wait_data_conditions: Unknown source identity, authority grade, owner, license or terms, public access eligibility, schema, product mapping, exact window, object identity, checksum, clock, revision, PIT meaning, size, storage or cost.
No exact D0 receipt and no explicitly supplied exact raw artifact.
No admitted sequence or finer-grained data to resolve a replay ambiguity.
No safely available independent source needed for a declared cross-check.
rework_local_conditions: Deterministic schema, type, hash, canonicalization, path, mutation, validator, fixture, chronology or receipt defect confined to the E0 allowlist.
A missing test or report field whose repair needs no new source, authority, phase or scope.
Non-matching physical or canonical identity caused by local candidate construction.
rework_route_conditions: Required scope cannot be satisfied without modifying an existing artifact.
PITAR1 cannot remain independent from terminal P1A, S0-009, active G1 or Application Support.
A requested D3 comparison actually requires E2 scoring.
A required source is paid, authenticated, legally unclear or exceeds the zero-cost resource ceiling.
The stage contract, immutable authority, chronology roles or real-permission boundary must change.
acceptance_and_failure_contract.hard_precedence: Authority mismatch, scope breach, future leakage, raw overwrite, candidate self-acceptance, old-lineage import or real-permission escalation dominates local scores and immediately fails closed.

daily_builder_and_tester.scope: Build allowlisted artifacts, run deterministic synthetic and adversarial tests, perform bounded official-document discovery and report exact facts.

independent_fact_reviewer.scope: Recompute physical and canonical identities and reproduce attacks without the builder's helper constructors.

allowed_invocations: Complete PITAR1-E0, D0, D1, D2 or D3 stage candidate
A genuine authority, chronology, scope or stage blocker
The same root cause remains unresolved after two complete Terra-high repair rounds
not_for: Ordinary schema, type, naming, fixture or deterministic local test repair
Routine daily implementation or status reporting

escalation_payload_required: Two Terra-high repair receipts when applicable
Proposed WAIT_DATA, REWORK_LOCAL or REWORK_ROUTE disposition

open_findings.condition: Natural-language hard falsifier and expiry descriptions are not executable predicates.
open_findings.this_decision_effect: UNCHANGED. PITAR1 does not close or weaken this finding.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: This decision finds a clean independent PITAR1 successor route feasible and authorizes only thirteen exact E0 artifacts plus bounded official grade-A or grade-B document discovery and a non-executing D0 plan candidate. It grants no market-row acquisition, raw admission, adapter, replay, dataset, comparison, calibration, paper, deployment or trading permission; it does not revive P1A, change CORE_TRADING_THEORY.v2.1, alter active G1 or close F-005/DSP-022.
